text: Impact 3.0 shortens the lag between donors taking their tax deductions and the donated funds actually reaching impact projects, which is a capital allocation timing failure of Impact 1.0 and 2.0.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Impact Investing Innovation - From Impact 1.0 to 3.0 (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4685567

isBasedOn.name: Impact Investing Innovation - From Impact 1.0 to 3.0

abstract: Impact 3.0 improves on Impact 1.0 and 2.0 capital allocation timeframes, lowering the time between donors receiving their tax deductions and deploying the donated funds to the impact projects.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: donors receiving tax deductions in advance of deployment
